title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria Dedicated Server

server_name.title: World Name
server_name.description: World to load or create. This is also the name players see when searching for the session.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Optional case-sensitive password required to join the server.

world_file_name.title: Optional World Filename
world_file_name.description: Optional save filename used when multiple saves have the same world name. Leave empty to select by world name.

world_seed.title: World Seed
world_seed.description: Use random or an integer seed when creating a new world.

game_mode.title: World Type
game_mode.description: World type used only when creating a new world.

difficulty_preset.title: Difficulty Preset
difficulty_preset.description: Difficulty used only when creating a new world. Choose custom to apply the individual difficulty fields.

combat_difficulty.title: Combat Difficulty
combat_difficulty.description: Base enemy damage and hit points for custom difficulty.

enemy_aggression.title: Enemy Aggression
enemy_aggression.description: How often enemies attack and how many attack at once for custom difficulty.

survival_difficulty.title: Survival Difficulty
survival_difficulty.description: Buff strength and stamina, energy, hunger, and despair rates for custom difficulty.

mining_drops.title: Mining Drops
mining_drops.description: Ore volume dropped from each vein for custom difficulty.

world_drops.title: World Drops
world_drops.description: Enemy reward drop rates for custom difficulty.

horde_frequency.title: Horde Frequency
horde_frequency.description: How often noisy actions trigger an orc horde for custom difficulty.

siege_frequency.title: Siege Frequency
siege_frequency.description: How often orcs attack a dwarf base for custom difficulty.

patrol_frequency.title: Patrol Frequency
patrol_frequency.description: How often enemy groups spawn for custom difficulty.

optional_dlc_array.title: New World DLC
optional_dlc_array.description: Comma-separated DLC identifiers enabled when creating a new world. DurinsFolk is the current upstream default.

upgrade_optional_dlc_array.title: Existing World DLC Upgrade
upgrade_optional_dlc_array.description: Comma-separated DLC identifiers to apply when an existing world next loads. Empty skips upgrading. DurinsFolk is documented; upgrading is irreversible and requires a world backup.

advertise_address.title: Advertise Address
advertise_address.description: Address reported to clients: auto, local, or an explicit IPv4 or IPv6 address.

advertise_port.title: Advertise Port
advertise_port.description: External port reported to clients. Leave empty to use the managed listen port.

initial_connection_retry_seconds.title: Initial Connection Retry
initial_connection_retry_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to retry if the server fails to host on launch.

after_disconnection_retry_seconds.title: Rehost Retry
after_disconnection_retry_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to try rehosting after the hosted session drops.

console_enabled.title: Enable Console
console_enabled.description: Keeps the dedicated server console enabled for operator commands.

server_fps.title: Server Frame-Rate Limit (FPS)
server_fps.description: Server frame-rate limit. The official guide recommends 60; try 30 if CPU usage is too high.

loaded_area_limit.title: Loaded Area Limit
loaded_area_limit.description: Maximum areas kept loaded. The upstream default 12 is intended for eight-player sessions.

rules_message.title: Rules Message
rules_message.description: Optional text shown when players join, written to MoriaServerRules.txt.

permissions_lines.title: Permissions Lines
permissions_lines.description: Complete native permissions file: default permissions, player usernames, construction/storage permissions and Blocked status. Edit while stopped; preserve other player entries.

extra_launch_args.title: Extra Launch Arguments
extra_launch_args.description: Optional raw launch arguments appended after LanGame materializes the native server files.
